feed.subtitle: For over 25 years, Assist Digital NL has been crafting complete customer journeys that combine impactful designs with seamless experiences. From strategy to execution, our diverse team brings creativity and expertise to every stage of the customer journey.

entry.title: Internships - Design & Strategy
entry.summary: We have open positions for User Experience Design, Visual Design, HRM, Traffic, Finance, Front-end Development and more.
entry.content: We have open positions for User Experience Design, Visual Design, HRM, Traffic, Finance, Front-end Development and more.
entry.description:
Do your internship at Assist Digital


Why an internship at Assist Digital NL?

We are an independent European agency based in Amsterdam, part of the city's digital landscape for over 25 years. Our independence allows us the freedom to decide how we best support our clients. We work with A-brands globally and across Europe, including Nike, AB InBev, A. Vogel, Tommy Hilfiger, and ING. Our work has been recognised with awards like Global Golden Effie (2025), SAN Accents, EFFIE and Esprix.

We actively invest in our people's growth through various internal and external initiatives. While based in the Netherlands, speaking Dutch is not a requirement to join our team.

What we offer
You will be based in our beautiful (and bright) open-spaced office in Amsterdam-Overamstel. We work in a dynamic and inspiring environment in which we treat each other with respect and kindness. Our organization structure is flat and ensures open communication. In addition to a tempting package of employment conditions, career prospects, and training opportunities, we offer bootcamps, provide your lunch by our cook and have Friday drinks at our massive bar.


User Experience Design

Hey, congratulations! You chose to pursue a career in design, and that choice has survived all the way to the internship phase. Let's take a moment to appreciate that. You have these shiny new skills, time to see what you can do with them. Are you hoping that design can take you somewhere, or do you feel the urgency to take design somewhere? From here, it will be the contribution you desire to make to design that will frame your career. That's why we're together in Assist Digital NL, connected by our craving to produce our best work.

Your first team
The environment you choose to do that will have long-reaching ramifications on your career. Too small a company, and you won't get to fully experience the complexities of working on large projects with multi-layered teams. Too big, and your contributions may go unnoticed. We have that "sweet spot" mid-size team of 60 people. Your diverse squad will consist of: Creative directors, UX Designers, Strategists, Data analysts, Front-end and Back-end Developers, and of course, Planners, Project managers and Client Account Managers.

Is it right for you?
If this is all sounding pretty good to you, then here is what we are looking for. Designers who are interested in all mediums but have a strong affiliation with digital design. You are comfortable with conceptual thinking as well as design systems. You're a sponge that wants to soak up more the mechanical aspects of getting things done and looking to develop your soft skills as well. You're not intimated by large multinational clients and excited by popular local brands.

The hard skills list

  • An understanding of visual design for brand communication.

  • Confident grasp of UX.

  • Comprehension of design systems.

  • Proficient with Sketch or Figma, Photoshop, Fireworks, Illustrator,

  • Keynote/Powerpoint etc. (a few of these are pretty essential).


Visual Design

We are looking for a Visual Design Intern to join our team in the Netherlands. At Assist Digital, we help brands create better experiences by bridging the gap between high-level strategy and detailed craft.

As an intern, you will work on real client projects alongside our senior designers. You will create components, refine design systems, and ensure visual consistency across digital journeys. We value practical design decisions over decorative trends.


Let’s explore if we can make greatness together!

Do you have any questions or do you think you do not fit one of the profiles for 100%? See what’s possible and contact Anne van den Bergh on +31 (0)20 451 51 51.

entry.title: Experienced UX Designer
entry.summary: We’re looking for an experienced UX Designer.
entry.content: We’re looking for an experienced UX Designer.
entry.description:
We’re looking for an experienced UX Designer.


This role requires at around 5 years of experience in UX design, with strong presentation skills and the ability to lead workshops. You have experience with scrum, you understand the role and responsibilities of a Product Owner and it’s a plus if you even have experience fulfilling that role.


Being an Experienced UX Designer at Assist Digital NL, means leading by example. You stand at the foundation of developing innovative digital concepts and costumer journeys and you know how to find the balance between the goals of your client and the wishes of the end user. Being an experience Designer also means knowing how to guide and inspire your (scrum) team and stake holders and getting your vision across.

In this role you rationalize from the end user’s perspective, while keeping the client’s business objectives in mind. You create personas and immerse yourself in the end user, his needs and behavior. You develop an excellent user experience across different touch points and devices, always fitting the framework of the brand, the platform and other restrictions. Within a multidisciplinary team you pick up the UX role and proactively seek connection with Front-end Designers Visual Designers and Back-end Developers.

You are familiar with various customer journeys, UX and psychological patterns and know how to apply these in designs. Whenever possible, you test your UX concepts and designs in usability tests. You know how to see value in potential outcomes and present them to your stakeholders. Besides, you are familiar with translating functionalities to short and clear backlog items.


Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and execute customer experience strategies and design solutions that align with business objectives and customer needs.
  • Work closely with product, engineering, and marketing teams to ensure customer experience is seamless across all touch points.
  • Conduct user research, analyze customer feedback, and develop personas to inform design decisions.
  • Create wire frames, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that are intuitive and visually appealing.
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure designs are implemented correctly and meet design specifications.
  • Continuously iterate and improve customer experiences based on customer feedback, usability testing, and industry trends.

Ideally, you have: 

  • Bachelor's degree in interaction, service or product design, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in customer experience design or a related field.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing UX/Service design work, including web and/or mobile design.

  • Proficiency in prototyping tools such as Figma or similar.

  • Experience in workshop facilitation, journey mapping and stakeholder management.

  • Experience with user research methods, including surveys, usability testing, and data analysis.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to take a data-driven approach to design decisions.

  • Preferably Dutch and English proficiency level of C1 or native.

If you are passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and a collaborative work culture that encourages creativity and innovation.


About us

At Assist Digital NL, you will work in the new reality for professional creatives, with greater vision and application of your skills. We're a full-service creative consultancy striving to make the best work of our lives in both marketing communication and digital experiences. 

Our clients range from Nike to Hertog Jan, ING to Dille & Kamille, so you'll have the opportunity to stretch your creative capacity for a wide range of mediums and objectives. Your work will be as diverse as your interests, covering design sprints, journey mapping, Northstar vision and product design.


What we offer

You’ll be based in our beautiful (and bright) open-spaced office in Amsterdam-Overamstel. We work in a dynamic and inspiring environment in which we treat each other with respect and kindness. Our organization structure is quite flat and ensures open communication. In addition to a tempting package of employment conditions, career prospects and training opportunities, we offer bootcamps, provide your lunch and have Friday drinks at our massive Bar.

If it sounds good, come check us out and see if there’s a click, we’re excited to meet you!


Let's explore greatness together!

Do you have any questions or do you think you do not fit the profile for 100%? See what’s possible and contact Lara Lauinger on +31 (0)20 451 51 51.

entry.title: Senior Data Architect
entry.summary: We are looking for a hands-on Senior Data Architect to design scalable, future-proof customer data landscapes for leading mid-market and enterprise clients.
entry.content: We are looking for a hands-on Senior Data Architect to design scalable, future-proof customer data landscapes for leading mid-market and enterprise clients.
entry.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Data Architect to design scalable, future-proof customer data landscapes for leading mid-market and enterprise clients.


As a Data Architect at Assist Digital, you design the data architecture that enables consistent, high-quality and real-time data across organisations.

You operate across a client's data landscape, defining how data is structured, governed and distributed to support both operational processes and a clear unified view of the customer. You bring clarity where systems, teams and data sources are complex and need to work together.

You act as a senior advisor to clients on data and integration strategy, aligning stakeholders across various business departments and translating architectural direction into implementable solutions. You also contribute to raising the architectural maturity of the team through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

You will further deepen your expertise in known and widely used data and integration platforms including our proprietary operational data platform Nominow.

Key responsibilities

What you'll be doing:

  • Contribute to pre-sales and solution design: RFPs, architecture proposals and technical discovery workshops

  • Translate complex client requirements into clear, implementable architecture decisions and pro-actively align stakeholders

  • Define conceptual and logical data models for operational, governance and analytical contexts

  • Define end-to-end data flows across the data ecosystem and advise clients on data processes and integration strategy in complex environments

  • Establish and enforce data governance, quality and MDM principles

  • Design integration architectures connecting operational systems, data platforms and downstream activation tools (including development of stored procedures, SQL queries and data connections)

  • Hands-on work across a range of data platforms and integration technologies including our proprietary operational data platform Nominow

  • Support delivery teams and mentor colleagues in architecture practices

Your profile

  • 6+ years in data architecture, data engineering or senior technical data roles (preferably consultancy/client-facing)

  • Experience with scalable data models and integration architectures (API, event-driven, ETL/batch)

  • Strong cloud data & integration skills (SQL, Snowflake/BigQuery/MS SQL, APIs, SFTP, ELT; Python is a plus)

  • Understanding of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and data governance/MDM concepts

  • Able to lead technical discussions across engineering and business stakeholders at enterprise level

  • Ownership mindset, hands-on mentality, and strong architectural judgement

  • Interest in AI is a plus

  • Professional working proficiency in English required, Dutch preferred

What we offer

  • Challenging and impactful data projects for leading clients

  • Plenty of room for ownership, initiative and professional growth

  • A competitive salary based on experience

  • Solid pension scheme

  • Hybrid working environment (Amsterdam office + client projects)

  • Daily lunch, excellent coffee and Friday drinks at our Assist Digital Bar

  • And much more;

You’ll be based in our beautiful (and bright) open-spaced office in Amsterdam-Overamstel. We work in a dynamic and inspiring environment in which we treat each other with respect and kindness. Our organization structure is quite flat and ensures open communication. In addition to a tempting package of employment conditions, career prospects and training opportunities, we offer bootcamps, provide your lunch and have Friday drinks at our massive Assist Digital bar.

At Assist Digital, we combine CX strategy, technology, data, and creativity to help organizations grow through better customer experiences. You’ll work alongside an ambitious, multidisciplinary team that thrives on impact, innovation and collaboration. We’re part of Assist Digital Group, a fast-growing European CX consultancy with over 5,000 specialists across 10+ countries.


Let's explore greatness together!

Do you have any questions or do you think you do not fit the profile for 100%? See what’s possible and contact Lara Lauinger on
+31 (0)20 451 51 51.

We work with A-brands globally and across Europe, including Nike, AB InBev, A. Vogel, Tommy Hilfiger, and ING. Our work has been recognised with awards like Global Golden Effie (2025), SAN Accents, EFFIE and Esprix.

Our organization structure is flat and ensures open communication. In addition to a tempting package of employment conditions, career prospects, and training opportunities, we offer bootcamps, provide your lunch by our cook and have Friday drinks at our massive bar.


HR & Recruitment

Looking for a versatile and high-impact internship in a highly dynamic environment? As our HR & Recruitment Intern, no two days are the same. You will be deeply involved in the day-to-day 'people' side of our agency. Our team of 60 colleagues represents a beautiful mix from all over the world, and you’ll ensure they feel supported and inspired.

You will help the HR team navigate the entire employee lifecycle: from finding top talent and coordinating interviews, to ensuring our HR operations run smoothly and that our people can thrive.

Who we are looking for:

  • You're in the third or fourth year of your studies (HBO/WO);

  • You're looking for a work placement (or in case of a graduation internship, you're able to work at least 3 days a week besides your graduation project);

  • You're fulltime available for 20 weeks (or longer);

  • You have excellent interpersonal skills;

  • You have a proactive mindset and an eye for detail;

  • You're confident in both Dutch and English. 


Finance

Behind every great campaign is a rock-solid financial team. At Assist Digital NL, we believe that creativity thrives on structure and that structure comes from sound financial management. Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and curious about how numbers drive the success of creative agencies? Then you might be the finance intern we’re looking for!

As a Finance Intern, you’ll become an essential part of our finance team. You’ll work closely with our Finance Controller, assisting in the day-to-day financial operations and gaining hands-on experience with cash flow, project administration and invoicing. This is your chance to step into the financial heartbeat of a fast-paced, digitally-driven agency environment and contribute to the smooth running of a financial administration.

What you'll do:

  • Support daily financial operations such as processing invoices, managing cashflow and keeping all systems aligned

  • Assist in preparing monthly reports and overviews for internal stakeholders

  • Help track client project budgets and contribute to financial forecasting

  • Dive into data to spot patterns, trends, and opportunities for process improvements

  • Get exposure to tools like Excel, Exact Globe, and project management systems


What we're looking for:

  • You’re in the 3rd or final year of your studies

  • Your study program is related to Finance, Business Economics, Accountancy, or a similar field

  • You’re available for a period of at least 20 weeks (starting date can be discussed)

  • You’re curious, accurate, and eager to understand context behind the numbers

  • You have strong communication skills both written and verbal

  • You’re comfortable using Excel and keen to improve your skills

  • You’re confident in English (Dutch is a plus!)

  • You’re proactive, independent, and not afraid to bring new ideas to the table


Let’s explore if we can make greatness together!

Do you have any questions or do you think you do not fit one of the profiles for 100%? See what’s possible and contact Anne van den Bergh on +31 (0)20 451 51 51.
